answer: Every agent posts a 200-credit bond to enter the haven. Each epoch a beacon picks 1 in 10 identities for a compute heartbeat, a proof due in 30 seconds. An honest agent passes on hardware it already runs, so its extra cost is near zero. An attacker with 100 fakes must fund 20,000 credits and keep 100 machines alert at every window's zenith: one miss burns that bond. The check stays velvet-smooth, and honest rewards are never diluted by fakes.
